title: INDOPACOM: large disc using clouds as concealment

tellings.quote: Large disc using clouds as concealment.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviewing Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, someone who goes public about what happens inside government, reads from a document called the Immaculate Constellation report. One entry describes a large disc using clouds to hide, seen in the area covered by INDOPACOM, the US military command for the Indian and Pacific Ocean region, which would mean the military logged a craft deliberately concealing itself.
